title: Hybrid Exact and Metaheuristic Method for the Multiobjective Satellite Image Mosaic Selection Problem - code and reproduction data
description:
Solvers, experiment data and rebuild scripts for the paper Hybrid Exact and Metaheuristic Method for the Multiobjective Satellite Image Mosaic Selection Problem.

The deposit reproduces the paper's tables and figures end to end from a clean checkout:

publication-data/scene_catalogue/   (2,491 catalogue records, no imagery)
  -> generate_benchmark_instances.sh   -> 25 benchmark instances
  -> stored results and 850 anytime traces
  -> rebuild_paper_artifacts.sh        -> 16 tables and 29 figures

Verified on a clean checkout of this release: manifest 1,010 of 1,010 files match, instances 50 of 50 byte-identical, tables 16 of 16 and figures 29 of 29 byte-identical. Check any stage with python publication-data/scripts/make_manifest.py --check.

Licensing. Source code is MIT. Derived experimental outputs are CC BY 4.0. publication-data/scene_catalogue/ holds third-party satellite catalogue metadata and no imagery, redistributed with the attributions set out in publication-data/LICENSE.md: "© CNES (year of acquisition), Distribution Airbus DS" for Pléiades and SPOT records, and "© Airbus DS (year of acquisition)" for Pléiades Neo records.

Re-running the experiments needs a licensed Gurobi installation. Rebuilding the tables and figures from the stored results does not solve anything, but still compiles the Python extension and so needs Gurobi present at build time.
